# Forward Handoff Package: 9d527ad1 (capture hook usage telemetry)

## Objective

Populate `data_json.usage` in the session capture hook so token, cost, and model telemetry is non-zero end to end. The consuming data model already exists and is committed under 41ff230b; this ticket supplies the missing source data. When it lands, token/cost must light up automatically through the existing path with no changes to the consumer.

## Target Tickets

- 9d527ad1-616b-45fb-b67c-64e0396841fe (bug, state `new`, no dependencies, ready to start)
- Scheduling decision: 9d527ad1 runs BEFORE 8ad2581e. It is the real blocker for the cost half of this feature area, and spec 7be68a48 R4 depends on it.

## Target Files

- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/hook.rs — lines ~251-272 extract `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`, `model_id` from `data_json.get("usage")` and return `None` when absent. The extraction is correct; the writer that should emit `usage` is what is missing.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/store/config/persistence.rs — lines ~273-282 compute `cost_usd` only when `model_id`, `input_tokens`, and `output_tokens` are all `Some`. This gate should begin passing once usage is populated; do not relax it.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/subagent_rollup.rs — `compute_subagent_rollups` aggregates per delegated session. No change expected; verify aggregates become non-zero.

## Decisions

- HARD CONSTRAINT (carried forward, previously audited clean): no shim, stub, fallback, hardcoded value, default-zero, or parallel code path may be introduced to work around the null usage field. Token/cost must flow `SessionTurnEventMeta` -> `compute_subagent_rollups` and activate automatically. The 41ff230b implementation was audited and is clean on this point; keep it that way.
- `cost_usd` stays computed downstream in persistence.rs, not at capture time. The hook's job is to emit raw usage only.
- Unrecognized model ids resolve to a zero-cost budget in the price table. Emit the real price-table `model_id` (e.g. `claude-opus-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`), never a display label such as `Claude Opus 5 (copilot)`.

## Validation

- val-session-api-lib-suite (required) — `cargo test -p session-api --lib`, currently 148 passing; must not regress.
- val-session-api-build (required) — clean build of session-api.
- New coverage required: at least one test asserting a captured turn yields non-null `usage` and a non-zero rollup. Record it as a new test-api validation spec with a passing execution; do not put raw commands in the handoff record, which has no command field.

## Non-Goals

- No changes to the quality-gate types, `QualityGate`/`QualityGatePhase`/`QualityGateOutcome`, delivered under 41ff230b.
- No changes to the satisfactory-work-rate query surface (spec 7be68a48 R3).
- Ticket 8ad2581e is explicitly deferred until this lands.
- No backfill of historical sessions that already recorded null usage.

## Context Anchors

- Spec 7be68a48 — R1 gate definition, R2 collection architecture, R3 satisfactory-work-rate data model, R4 token/cost dependency on this ticket.
- Ticket 41ff230b (done) — consumer implementation and the six verified acceptance criteria.
- Commits: memory-api submodule f8165b8; root a2b46eb6, 59f5fcb0, a658523e.
- Predecessor handoff dcf86212 (its stale `passed-145-tests` outcome is corrected to 148 in this iteration).
- Epic 1fbf2d84 closure verified legitimate; all six children done.

## Open Escalations

None.

# Forward Handoff Package: 9d527ad1 (capture hook usage telemetry)

## Objective

Make token, cost, and model telemetry non-zero end to end by populating `data_json.usage`. The consuming data model is already built and committed under 41ff230b; this ticket supplies the missing source data. Once it lands, token/cost must light up automatically through the existing path with no changes to the consumer.

## Scope Decision (confirmed with user)

This ticket spans TWO surfaces and is intentionally NOT split:

1. **Producer side (primary, outside session-api): the VS Code extension layer.** `data_json` is inbound data — session-api only deserializes `CopilotHookPayload`. The crate cannot source token counts itself; anything it invented would violate the no-shim constraint. The VS Code extension layer is the confirmed producer and must emit `usage` on the hook event. This is the same surface previously chosen as the un-spoofable point for caller-model enforcement ("option C"), so the decision is consistent with prior architecture.
2. **Consumer side (secondary, in-crate): model_id fallback.** `CopilotHookPayload` already carries a payload-level `model` field, separate from per-event `data_json.usage`. When an event lacks a model id, fall back to the payload-level `model`. This is real data, not synthesis, and is no-shim-clean.

## Target Tickets

- 9d527ad1-616b-45fb-b67c-64e0396841fe (bug, state `new`, no dependencies, ready to start)
- Scheduling: 9d527ad1 runs BEFORE 8ad2581e. It is the real blocker for the cost half, and spec 7be68a48 R4 depends on it.
- Related (do not conflate): 8c67b96a — handoff record schema ownership defect.

## Target Files

Producer side:
- The VS Code extension layer that writes the Copilot hook payload. Identify the exact module first; it is outside the Rust crates. `CopilotRuntimeMetadata.producer` identifies the writer at runtime and is the fastest way to confirm the component.

Consumer side (memory-api/crates/session-api):
- src/hook.rs — `CopilotHookEvent.data_json` (~line 72) is the inbound field; extraction at ~lines 251-272 reads `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`, `model_id` from `data_json.get("usage")` and correctly returns `None` when absent. `CopilotHookPayload.model` (~line 114) is the fallback source for model_id. Extraction logic is correct; do not rewrite it.
- src/store/config/persistence.rs — ~lines 273-282 compute `cost_usd` only when `model_id`, `input_tokens`, and `output_tokens` are all `Some`. This gate should start passing once usage is populated. Do NOT relax it.
- src/subagent_rollup.rs — `compute_subagent_rollups` aggregates per delegated session. No change expected; verify aggregates become non-zero.

## Decisions

- HARD CONSTRAINT (carried forward, audited clean under 41ff230b): no shim, stub, fallback-to-zero, hardcoded value, or parallel code path may be introduced to work around null usage. Token/cost must flow `SessionTurnEventMeta` -> `compute_subagent_rollups` and activate automatically. Keep it that way. Note the model_id fallback in scope item 2 is NOT a violation: it reads a real, already-populated payload field rather than fabricating a value.
- `cost_usd` stays computed downstream in persistence.rs, not at capture time. The producer emits raw usage only.
- Emit the real price-table `model_id` (e.g. `claude-opus-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`), never a display label such as `Claude Opus 5 (copilot)`. Unrecognized ids resolve to a zero-cost budget and silently disable price-awareness enforcement.

## Validation

- val-session-api-lib-suite (required) — `cargo test -p session-api --lib`, currently 148 passing; must not regress.
- val-session-api-build (required) — clean build of session-api.
- New coverage required: a test asserting a captured turn yields non-null `usage` and a non-zero rollup, plus a test for the payload-level model_id fallback. Record as new test-api validation specs with passing executions; do not put raw commands in the handoff record, which has no command field.
- Producer-side change needs its own verification that a real captured session writes non-null `usage`.

## Non-Goals

- No changes to the quality-gate types `QualityGate`/`QualityGatePhase`/`QualityGateOutcome` delivered under 41ff230b.
- No changes to the satisfactory-work-rate query surface (spec 7be68a48 R3).
- Ticket 8ad2581e is deferred until this lands.
- No backfill of historical sessions that already recorded null usage.
- Handoff record schema ownership is out of scope; that is ticket 8c67b96a.

## Context Anchors

- Spec 7be68a48 — R1 gate definition, R2 collection architecture, R3 satisfactory-work-rate data model, R4 token/cost dependency on this ticket.

# Forward Handoff Package: 9d527ad1 (token/cost telemetry via mcp-cost-gate)

## Objective

Make token and cost telemetry non-zero for the traffic where it is actually observable, by recording real usage from the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy. Coverage is partial BY DESIGN and that boundary must be stated in the data, not hidden. The consuming data model already exists and is committed under 41ff230b; this ticket supplies real source data for the subset that can be measured honestly.

## Why the original plan was abandoned (verified, do not re-litigate)

Two independent research passes established:

- The raw Microsoft Copilot transcript JSONL (`%APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage/<workspace-id>/GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts/*.jsonl`) contains NO `usage` object and no token fields under any spelling (checked usage, tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, cache_read, cacheRead, cost, requestId) across 3 files.
- The raw transcript ALSO has no `model` field. `session.start` carries only `producer: "copilot-agent"`, `copilotVersion: "0.58.0"`, `vscodeVersion: "1.130.0"`.
- Therefore `hook/transcript.rs` (~line 171) hardcoding `model: None` is NOT the bug, and the extraction in `hook.rs` (~lines 251-272) is correct. The parser discards nothing that exists. Editing session-api alone CANNOT fix this.
- The producer is Microsoft's closed-source `GitHub.copilot` extension, unmodifiable from this repo. The only VS Code extension here is `memory-api/tools/ticket-vscode`, which does not touch Copilot capture.

The earlier plan (VS Code extension layer as producer + payload-level `model` fallback) is dead on both halves. Do not attempt it.

## Scope

Source telemetry from `mcp-cost-gate`, which already sits in the MCP call path and already knows `CALLER_MODEL`.

- Record real observed token/cost data for MCP tool traffic into the existing `SessionTurnEventMeta` -> `compute_subagent_rollups` path.
- Compute cost using the pricing tables that already exist: `tools/model-prices/model_prices.json`, and the per-model pricing in the Copilot debug-logs `models.json` (input_price, output_price, cache_price).
- Mark coverage explicitly so partial data is never mistaken for complete data. A consumer must be able to distinguish "no MCP traffic" from "telemetry unavailable".

## Target Tickets

- 9d527ad1-616b-45fb-b67c-64e0396841fe (bug, state `new`, no dependencies, ready to start)
- 8ad2581e-d9c0-4d24-b913-2b5ee77b2eeb already has a `depends_on` edge to this ticket; the ordering is enforced by the graph and is confirmed to stand.
- Do not conflate with 8c67b96a (handoff record schema ownership).

## Target Files

- memory-api/tools/mcp/mcp-cost-gate/src/ — the proxy; primary site for emitting observed usage.
- tools/model-prices/model_prices.json — authoritative price table keyed by `model_id`.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/subagent_rollup.rs — `compute_subagent_rollups`; verify aggregates become non-zero. No structural change expected.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/store/config/persistence.rs — ~lines 273-282 compute `cost_usd` only when `model_id`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens` are all `Some`. Do NOT relax this gate.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/hook.rs — read-only reference for the existing extraction contract. Do not rewrite it.

## Decisions

- HARD CONSTRAINT (standing, audited clean under 41ff230b): no shim, stub, fallback-to-zero, hardcoded value, estimated value, or parallel code path may fabricate token/cost data. Absent counts stay null. Honest absence beats fabricated precision.
- Local tokenizer estimation was explicitly considered and REJECTED: derived numbers presented as observed are worse than honest zeros.
- Partial coverage is accepted deliberately. The MCP-only boundary must be recorded in the data model, not left implicit.
- Use the real price-table `model_id` (e.g. `claude-opus-5`, `claude-haiku-4-5`), never a display label like `Claude Opus 5 (copilot)`. Unrecognized ids resolve to a zero-cost budget and silently disable price-awareness enforcement.
- Full per-turn fidelity is a KNOWN LIMITATION, not planned work. It unblocks only if Microsoft emits usage in the transcript format, or a future repo-local VS Code extension is built on the `vscode.lm` API.

## Validation

- val-session-api-lib-suite (required) — `cargo test -p session-api --lib`, currently 148 passing; must not regress.
- val-session-api-build (required) — clean build of session-api.
- New coverage required: a test proving an MCP tool call yields real non-zero token/cost in the rollup, and a test proving non-MCP traffic yields null rather than zero. Register these as new test-api validation specs with passing executions — the handoff record has no command field, so commands must live in `ValidationSpec.command`.

## Non-Goals

- No edits to `hook/transcript.rs` or `hook.rs` extraction logic; they are correct.
- No attempt to modify or intercept Microsoft's Copilot extension.
- No new repo-local VS Code extension in this ticket.
- No tokenizer-based estimation.
- No changes to `QualityGate`/`QualityGatePhase`/`QualityGateOutcome` (41ff230b) or the satisfactory-work-rate query surface (spec 7be68a48 R3).
- No backfill of historical sessions.
- Handoff schema ownership is ticket 8c67b96a.

## Context Anchors

- Spec 7be68a48 — R4 rewritten this iteration to record the external blocker, the mcp-cost-gate path, the partial-coverage boundary, and the no-fabrication constraint as normative. R1/R2/R3 unchanged.
- Ticket 41ff230b (done) — consumer implementation, six verified acceptance criteria, no-shim audit clean.
- Commits: memory-api submodule f8165b8; root a2b46eb6, 59f5fcb0, a658523e.
- Handoff 9cd7050b supersedes dcf86212.
- Prior art for the price gate: `CALLER_MODEL` plumbing and `evaluate()` in the mcp-cost-gate work.

## Open Escalations

None. The upstream data gap was researched and confirmed; the mcp-cost-gate path, the rejection of estimation, and the retained 8ad2581e ordering were all confirmed with the user this iteration.

# Forward Handoff Package: 9d527ad1 (per-tool-call token-load telemetry)

## Objective

Make token-load telemetry non-zero for MCP tool traffic by recording real observed payload sizes and estimated token load from the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy. Coverage is partial BY DESIGN and that boundary must be stated in the data, not hidden. The consuming data model already exists and is committed under 41ff230b; this ticket supplies real source data for the subset that can be measured honestly.

## Why the original plan was abandoned (verified, do not re-litigate)

Three independent research passes established:

- The raw Microsoft Copilot transcript JSONL (`%APPDATA%/Code/User/workspaceStorage/<workspace-id>/GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts/*.jsonl`) contains NO `usage` object and no token fields under any spelling (checked usage, tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, cache_read, cacheRead, cost, requestId) across 3 files.
- The raw transcript ALSO has no `model` field. `session.start` carries only `producer: \"copilot-agent\"`, `copilotVersion: \"0.58.0\"`, `vscodeVersion: \"1.130.0\"`.
- Therefore `hook/transcript.rs` (~line 171) hardcoding `model: None` is NOT the bug, and the extraction in `hook.rs` (~lines 251-272) is correct. The parser discards nothing that exists. Editing session-api alone CANNOT fix this.
- **NEW THIS ITERATION**: MCP `tools/call` results carry no `usage` field; no repo MCP server emits one; `mcp-cost-gate`'s `proxy.rs` passes non-`tools/list` responses through untouched. Token counts are therefore NOT observable at the proxy. Having `caller_model` and a price table yields price-per-token, not token counts. The dollar-cost path is as blocked as the transcript path.
- The producer is Microsoft's closed-source `GitHub.copilot` extension, unmodifiable from this repo. The only VS Code extension here is `memory-api/tools/ticket-vscode`, which does not touch Copilot capture.

The earlier plan (VS Code extension layer as producer + payload-level `model` fallback) is dead on both halves. The revised plan (compute dollar cost from proxy-observed MCP usage + price tables) is also dead: the proxy sees payloads, not usage. Do not attempt either.

## Scope

Source telemetry from `mcp-cost-gate`, which already sits in the MCP call path and already knows `CALLER_MODEL`.

- Record real observed **payload size** (request and response byte/char counts) and **estimated token load** (derived via a fixed char-per-token divisor) for MCP tool traffic into the existing `SessionTurnEventMeta` -> `compute_subagent_rollups` path.
- Mark coverage explicitly so partial data is never mistaken for complete data. A consumer must be able to distinguish \"no MCP traffic\" from \"telemetry unavailable\".
- Do NOT compute dollar cost. Tools do not have a dollar cost; a tool call's only cost effect is the tokens it adds to the consuming agent's context, and the dollar cost arises there, in that agent's model billing.

## Target Tickets

- 9d527ad1-616b-45fb-b67c-64e0396841fe (bug, state `new`, no dependencies, ready to start)
- 8ad2581e-d9c0-4d24-b913-2b5ee77b2eeb already has a `depends_on` edge to this ticket; the ordering is enforced by the graph and is confirmed to stand. It consumes this metadata/token-load stream.
- Do not conflate with 8c67b96a (handoff record schema ownership).

## Target Files

- memory-api/tools/mcp/mcp-cost-gate/src/ — the proxy; primary site for emitting observed payload size and estimated token load.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/subagent_rollup.rs — `compute_subagent_rollups`; verify aggregates become non-zero. No structural change expected.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/store/config/persistence.rs — ~lines 273-282 compute `cost_usd` only when `model_id`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens` are all `Some`. This gate stays as-is and keeps returning null at this boundary.
- memory-api/crates/session-api/src/hook.rs — read-only reference for the existing extraction contract. Do not rewrite it.

## Decisions

1. **Tools do not have a dollar cost.** A tool call has no price of its own. Its only cost effect is the tokens it adds to the consuming agent's context, and the dollar cost arises there, in that agent's model billing. Therefore this ticket measures **token load of a tool call**, never a dollar figure.

2. **No pricing, no cost field, in this ticket.** Do not compute `cost_usd`. Do not add `cost_usd_estimated`. Do not consult `tools/model-prices/model_prices.json` or the debug-log `models.json` price tables. The `cost_usd` gate in `memory-api/crates/session-api/src/store/config/persistence.rs` (~lines 273-282) stays untouched and keeps returning null at this boundary.

3. **Record raw observed size plus an estimated token load.** At the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy, record per call: `timestamp`, `caller_model` (when supplied), tool name, `grant_id`, gate decision, request byte/char size, response byte/char size, `duration_ms`, and an estimated token load.

4. **Estimation method: fixed char-per-token divisor** (chars/4) over the serialized request and response payloads. No tokenizer dependency. A rough empirical signal that is proportional to real token consumption is explicitly sufficient — this is the user's stated bar.

5. The estimate must be **named and typed so it can never be read as an observed count or as a dollar cost** (e.g., `tokens_estimated`, derived from `chars`). The last iteration's blanket rejection of estimation is **reversed only for token load**, and remains in force for dollar cost.

6. Partial coverage (MCP traffic only) remains accepted and must stay explicit in the data so \"no MCP traffic\" is distinguishable from \"telemetry unavailable\".

7. HARD CONSTRAINT (standing, audited clean under 41ff230b): no shim, stub, fallback-to-zero, hardcoded value, or parallel code path may fabricate **dollar cost** data. Absent cost stays null. Honest absence beats fabricated precision. (Token estimation is explicitly exempt from this constraint under decision 5.)

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **AC1 (Observed payload size recorded)**: An MCP tool call records non-zero request and response byte/char counts in the proxy telemetry stream.

2. **AC2 (Estimated token load recorded)**: The same MCP tool call records a non-zero `tokens_estimated` derived from the serialized payload character count (chars/4 divisor).

3. **AC3 (Estimation is monotonic in payload size)**: Larger payloads yield larger `tokens_estimated`; the relationship is proportional.

4. **AC4 (Non-MCP traffic records null, not zero)**: Traffic that does not flow through the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy records `null` for these fields rather than zero, preserving the honest-absence boundary.

5. **AC5 (cost_usd remains null)**: The `cost_usd` field in `session-api` records remains `null` throughout; no dollar-cost computation occurs at this boundary.

6. **AC6 (Partial coverage is explicit)**: The data model distinguishes \"no MCP traffic\" (zero tool calls) from \"telemetry unavailable\" (null fields for non-MCP paths).

## Validation

- val-session-api-lib-suite (required) — `cargo test -p session-api --lib`, currently 148 passing; must not regress.
- val-session-api-build (required) — clean build of session-api.
- New coverage required: a test proving an MCP tool call yields real non-zero `tokens_estimated` and byte/char counts in the rollup, and a test proving non-MCP traffic yields null rather than zero. Register these as new test-api validation specs with passing executions — the handoff record has no command field, so commands must live in `ValidationSpec.command`.

## Non-Goals

- No edits to `hook/transcript.rs` or `hook.rs` extraction logic; they are correct.
- No attempt to modify or intercept Microsoft's Copilot extension.
- No new repo-local VS Code extension in this ticket.
- No tokenizer-based exact token counting.
- No dollar-cost computation.
- No price-table lookup (`tools/model-prices/model_prices.json` or debug-log `models.json`).
- No changes to `QualityGate`/`QualityGatePhase`/`QualityGateOutcome` (41ff230b) or the satisfactory-work-rate query surface (spec 7be68a48 R3).
- No backfill of historical sessions.
- Handoff schema ownership is ticket 8c67b96a.

## Context Anchors

- Spec 7be68a48 — R4 rewritten this iteration to record the proxy limitation (observes payloads, not usage), the token-load-only measurement boundary, the estimation method, the partial-coverage boundary, and the no-dollar-cost constraint as normative. R1/R2/R3 unchanged.
- Ticket 41ff230b (done) — consumer implementation, six verified acceptance criteria, no-shim audit clean.
- Commits: memory-api submodule f8165b8; root a2b46eb6, 59f5fcb0, a658523e.
- Handoff 9cd7050b supersedes dcf86212.
- Prior art for the price gate: `CALLER_MODEL` plumbing and `evaluate()` in the mcp-cost-gate work.

## Open Escalations

None. The upstream data gap (transcript and proxy both lack usage) was researched and confirmed; the mcp-cost-gate path, the token-load-only measurement, the chars/4 estimation method, the reversal of the estimation rejection for token load only, and the retained 8ad2581e ordering were all confirmed with the user this iteration.

Do not consult `tools/model-prices/model_prices.json` or the debug-log `models.json` price tables. The `cost_usd` gate in `memory-api/crates/session-api/src/store/config/persistence.rs` (~lines 273-282) stays untouched and keeps returning null at this boundary.

3. **Record raw observed size plus an estimated token load.** At the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy, record per call: `timestamp`, `caller_model` (when supplied), tool name, `grant_id`, gate decision, request byte/char size, response byte/char size, `duration_ms`, and an estimated token load.

4. **Estimation method: fixed char-per-token divisor** (chars/4) over the serialized request and response payloads. No tokenizer dependency. A rough empirical signal that is proportional to real token consumption is explicitly sufficient — this is the user's stated bar.

5. The estimate must be **named and typed so it can never be read as an observed count or as a dollar cost** (e.g., `tokens_estimated`, derived from `chars`). The last iteration's blanket rejection of estimation is **reversed only for token load**, and remains in force for dollar cost.

6. Partial coverage (MCP traffic only) remains accepted and must stay explicit in the data so \"no MCP traffic\" is distinguishable from \"telemetry unavailable\".

7. HARD CONSTRAINT (standing, audited clean under 41ff230b): no shim, stub, fallback-to-zero, hardcoded value, or parallel code path may fabricate **dollar cost** data. Absent cost stays null. Honest absence beats fabricated precision. (Token estimation is explicitly exempt from this constraint under decision 5.)

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **AC1 (Observed payload size recorded)**: An MCP tool call records non-zero request and response byte/char counts in the proxy telemetry stream.

2. **AC2 (Estimated token load recorded)**: The same MCP tool call records a non-zero `tokens_estimated` derived from the serialized payload character count (chars/4 divisor).

3. **AC3 (Estimation is monotonic in payload size)**: Larger payloads yield larger `tokens_estimated`; the relationship is proportional.

4. **AC4 (Non-MCP traffic records null, not zero)**: Traffic that does not flow through the `mcp-cost-gate` proxy records `null` for these fields rather than zero, preserving the honest-absence boundary.

5. **AC5 (cost_usd remains null)**: The `cost_usd` field in `session-api` records remains `null` throughout; no dollar-cost computation occurs at this boundary.

6. **AC6 (Partial coverage is explicit)**: The data model distinguishes \"no MCP traffic\" (zero tool calls) from \"telemetry unavailable\" (null fields for non-MCP paths).

## Validation

- val-session-api-lib-suite (required) — `cargo test -p session-api --lib`, currently 148 passing; must not regress.
- val-session-api-build (required) — clean build of session-api.
- New coverage required: a test proving an MCP tool call yields real non-zero `tokens_estimated` and byte/char counts in the rollup, and a test proving non-MCP traffic yields null rather than zero. Register these as new test-api validation specs with passing executions — the handoff record has no command field, so commands must live in `ValidationSpec.command`.

## Non-Goals

- No edits to `hook/transcript.rs` or `hook.rs` extraction logic; they are correct.
- No attempt to modify or intercept Microsoft's Copilot extension.
- No new repo-local VS Code extension in this ticket.
- No tokenizer-based exact token counting.
- No dollar-cost computation.
- No price-table lookup (`tools/model-prices/model_prices.json` or debug-log `models.json`).
- No changes to `QualityGate`/`QualityGatePhase`/`QualityGateOutcome` (41ff230b) or the satisfactory-work-rate query surface (spec 7be68a48 R3).
- No backfill of historical sessions.
- Handoff schema ownership is ticket 8c67b96a.

## Context Anchors

- Spec 7be68a48 — R4 rewritten this iteration to record the proxy limitation (observes payloads, not usage), the token-load-only measurement boundary, the estimation method, the partial-coverage boundary, and the no-dollar-cost constraint as normative. R1/R2/R3 unchanged.
- Ticket 41ff230b (done) — consumer implementation, six verified acceptance criteria, no-shim audit clean.
- Commits: memory-api submodule f8165b8; root a2b46eb6, 59f5fcb0, a658523e.
- Handoff 9cd7050b supersedes dcf86212.
- Prior art for the price gate: `CALLER_MODEL` plumbing and `evaluate()` in the mcp-cost-gate work.

## Open Escalations

None. The upstream data gap (transcript and proxy both lack usage) was researched and confirmed; the mcp-cost-gate path, the token-load-only measurement, the chars/4 estimation method, the reversal of the estimation rejection for token load only, and the retained 8ad2581e ordering were all confirmed with the user this iteration.
